description: A React functional component implementing a student search/filter bar with various input fields, validation, and debounced change handling.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Updates local state for a specific field.

methods.name: validDate
methods.description: Validates if a date string matches YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Trims input fields, validates date formats, and checks date range logic.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, normalizes data, and calls onSubmit prop.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Resets all input fields to empty and triggers onSubmit with cleared filters.
